map.输入轴承直径、长度、转速、载荷及工况，计算比压、PV值、所需油量并推荐润滑方式: Enter the bearing diameter, length, speed, load and working conditions to compute the specific pressure, PV value and required oil volume, and to recommend a lubrication method
map.比压 p=W/A、PV=p·v 校核润滑状态。: Specific pressure p = W/A and PV = p·v are used to check the lubrication regime.
map.按供油量与功耗选定泵与管路。: Choose the pump and the pipework from the flow rate and the power draw.
map.：载荷 W=5 kN、投影面积 A=50×20=1000 mm²、v=2 m/s: Load W=5 kN, projected area A=50×20=1000 mm² and v=2 m/s: p=5000/1000=5 MPa; PV=5×2=10 MPa·m/s. Below the allowable value, hydrodynamic lubrication holds.
map.：流量 Q=10 L/min、供油压力 0.5 MPa：泵功率≈p·Q/60=0: Flow Q=10 L/min and supply pressure 0.5 MPa: pump power ≈ p·Q/60 = 0.5×10/60 ≈ 0.083 kW (ignoring efficiency).
map.车削/铣削切削速度与进给量: Turning and milling cutting speed and feed rate
map.PV 超限怎么办？: What if the PV value is exceeded?
map.增大面积、降速、换高 PV 材料（如加青铜/PTFE）或改强制润滑，否则进入边界: Increase the contact area, reduce the speed, switch to a high PV material (such as adding bronze or PTFE), or switch to forced lubrication; otherwise you enter boundary lubrication.
map.需足够速度、粘度与间隙形成楔形油膜，低速重载易转为边界润滑，需极压添加剂。: It needs enough speed, viscosity and clearance to build a wedge-shaped oil film; low speed under heavy load tends to shift to boundary lubrication, so extreme-pressure additives are needed.
